key_points: ENB completed a $2.55 billion acquisition of Blackstone-owned Tallgrass Energy's crude oil business
Deal expands ENB's U.S. liquids pipeline footprint significantly
Includes 75% stake in Pony Express Pipeline and 51% interest in Powder River Gateway
Adds contracted cash flows and strengthens ENB's position in North American energy markets
Minor pre-announcement dip (0.764% on 11 Sept 2026) suggests initial market caution
